---
title: "AEE - Advanced Environment Extension"
---

::: {.hero}
# Advanced Environment Extension

**Physically accurate environment simulation for Arma 3.**

Elevation lapse rates, terrain microclimate, true air density, Koppen
biomes, thermal and physiological effects, optics, mobility, maritime
state, radio propagation, and atmospheric events.

::: {.hero-actions}
[Explore the modules](chapters/modules.qmd){.btn .btn-aee-primary}
[Start developing](chapters/development.qmd){.btn .btn-aee-ghost}
[GitHub](https://github.com/lErrorl404l/AEE){.btn .btn-aee-ghost}
:::
:::

## What AEE models

::: {.cards}
::: {.card}
### Atmosphere
Pressure, humidity, wind, fog, clouds, turbulence, icing, lightning,
microbursts, and pressure trends.
[Module reference](chapters/modules.qmd#sec-modules){.card-link}
:::

::: {.card}
### Temperature
Solar-elevation diurnal model, lapse rate, surface effects, wind chill,
heat index, WBGT, water temperature, and thermal crossover.
[Physics](chapters/physics.qmd#sec-physics){.card-link}
:::

::: {.card}
### Ballistics
True air density from temperature, pressure, and humidity, with
crosswind and Coriolis deflection.
[Formulas](annexes/annex-a-formulas.qmd#sec-annex-a){.card-link}
:::

::: {.card}
### Optics
Glare, mirage, thermal contrast, rain and dew on optics, snow blindness,
heat shimmer, and atmospheric seeing.
[Module reference](chapters/modules.qmd#sec-modules){.card-link}
:::

::: {.card}
### Mobility
Engine derating, helicopter lift, traction, mud accretion, soil bearing
strength, and route degradation.
[Module reference](chapters/modules.qmd#sec-modules){.card-link}
:::

::: {.card}
### Environment
Koppen biomes, seasonal foliage, snow, crop and fire risk, floods,
avalanches, dust, CBRN persistence, and lunar illumination.
[Module reference](chapters/modules.qmd#sec-modules){.card-link}
:::

::: {.card}
### Maritime
Sea state on the Beaufort scale, wave height, tides, and compass
deviation.
[Module reference](chapters/modules.qmd#sec-modules){.card-link}
:::

::: {.card}
### Physiology
UV index, heat acclimatisation, dehydration, battery derating, scent
dispersion, and altitude adaptation.
[Module reference](chapters/modules.qmd#sec-modules){.card-link}
:::

::: {.card}
### Radio
VHF, UHF, and HF propagation under atmospheric conditions.
[Module reference](chapters/modules.qmd#sec-modules){.card-link}
:::
:::

## Key facts

::: {.facts}
- Standalone: requires only CBA_A3.
- Deterministic across machines: the same state on every client.
- 50 shared `aee_core_*` state variables.
- 18 addons, 5 of them optional host-mod compatibility layers.
- Version 1.0.0, GPL-2.0-or-later with a PBO-distribution exception.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
